$comment: Feature 020: Settings -> Imports, Settings -> OCR, and shared OCR language pack labels (English). Deep-merged into en.json by i18n/index.ts.

tabs.imports: Default import options for supported e-book and document formats
tabs.ocr: Offline OCR language packs, automatic language detection, and custom OCR folder

pdf.useOcr: Use OCR for scanned or image-based text
pdf.useOcrHint: Sets the initial state of the Use OCR checkbox in File -> Import -> PDF File... when the editor starts, and the initial default for Batch Converter. Text-only PDFs and editor-exported PDFs never run OCR.

settings.noSettings: This format has no import settings yet.

settings.downloadNote: Higher-accuracy language models (tessdata_best) and additional languages can be downloaded and placed into your OCR folder. Files placed in your OCR folder override bundled packs with the same name.
settings.downloadLink: Download Tesseract OCR language files (tessdata_best / tessdata_fast)
settings.folderMissing: The chosen OCR folder {{path}} does not exist; default and bundled folders are used.
settings.folderUnreadable: The chosen OCR folder {{path}} cannot be read; default and bundled folders are used.
settings.autoDetectHint: When enabled, OCR detects page orientation and language(s) across the checked languages below. Turn off to force Tesseract to use all checked languages directly.
settings.languagesHint: Only checked installed languages are considered during OCR and automatic detection.
settings.noEnabledInstalled: Select at least one installed OCR language before saving.
settings.noPacksInstalled: No valid OCR language packs were found.
settings.unavailable: OCR catalog is unavailable: the editor core is not connected.
settings.osdMissing: Orientation detection data (osd.traineddata) was not found; rotated scan detection is unavailable.
